items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah, we played a lot of things together. ... We were on that CTI tour. ... We’ve done recordings with Quincy, of course, and some other things we’ve done together

ctx.x: Charles Earland? I’m just going to read through them, because, like I said, 333 sessions. So unless that’s something that’s memorable, I’m just going to – I’m going to throw the name out.
Charles Earland? You know what? When I hear that name, it reminds me of Lee Morgan got shot. We did that session that afternoon, and that night he got shot.
That’s right, because Lee is on this date.
